title: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte
summary: Bookmark this page for Rappler's comprehensive coverage of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial at the Senate

blocks.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte — the first Philippine public official to be impeached twice by the House of Representatives — began at 2 pm on Monday, July 6.

There are four articles of impeachment against Duterte involving alleged misuse of confidential funds, unexplained wealth, bribery of Department of Education officials, and grave threats against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and his family.

Only 21 out of 24 senator-judges are physically present. Senator Bato dela Rosa remains in hiding as he faces an International Criminal Court arrest warrant over Rodrigo Duterte’s drug war, Senator Jinggoy Estrada has been detained and suspended in connection with a plunder case, and Senator Rodante Marcoleta surrendered to authorities as he also faces a plunder case.
On this page, we bring you the latest updates, analyses, videos, and photos as the trial of the Vice President unfolds.

blocks.text: Sep 16, 2026 3:01 PM PHT
Escudero explains why he made initial decision on 16-vote conviction threshold
Presiding officer Chiz Escudero explains why he initially made a ruling on the conviction threshold debate, saying he had hoped that someone would elevate the matter to the Supreme Court.
“Ang pinakaayaw kong makitang mangyari, pagkatapos nating pagbotohan… hindi pa rin iyon ang tuldok sa isyu ng impeachment,” Escudero says.

“Sana kung saka-sakali, anumang pasya ng Senado, maging pinal o magpapasyahan nang pinal ng Korte Suprema nang sa gayon, kapag ito’y pinagbotohan sa katapusan ng kasong ito, iyon na rin ang katapusan ng usaping ito.”
